description:
Gentle Morning Music 🌿 Bansuri 432 Hz for Anxiety & Stress Relief and Mental Clarity

There is no rush this morning. Let the day arrive slowly - one breath, one long flute note at a time.

This soft bansuri music, tuned to 432 Hz, is made for gentle mornings: easing anxiety, settling stress, and giving you a clear, quiet head before the day asks anything of you.

Enjoy 1.5 hours of slow Indian bamboo flute in Raga Bhairavi over a steady tanpura drone, with no drums, no vocals and no ads interrupting.

▶ Keep going - the full Healing & Anxiety Relief playlist:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VIDEO_ID&list=PLeZN0byo199k-_9PNqaU2-Z_KhRN_X1hF
(paste this video's own id in place of VIDEO_ID before publishing - it opens the playlist at this video so the next one plays automatically)

Perfect for slow mornings, morning meditation, journaling, a quiet cup of tea, gentle stretching or yoga, breathwork, getting ready for the day, or calming morning anxiety.

🎵 ABOUT THIS MUSIC
Instrument: Bansuri (Indian bamboo flute) with tanpura drone
Raga: Bhairavi (a gentle, devotional raga)
Tuning: 432 Hz
Style: Indian classical instrumental, meditative
Mood: Soft, warm, unhurried
Atmosphere: A sunlit terrace, birds, nowhere to be yet
Duration: 1 hour 30 minutes

🎧 HOW TO USE
Play it as soon as you wake up. Sit or lie still for the first few minutes and let each long note lengthen your out-breath.

⏱ CHAPTERS
0:00 Waking slowly
9:00 First light
18:00 A longer breath
27:00 Worry loosening
36:00 Shoulders softening
45:00 A clearer head
54:00 Warm and steady
1:03:00 Easing into today
1:12:00 Calm all the way through
1:21:00 Ready, gently

⏱ BEST FOR
• Morning anxiety
• Stress relief
• Mental clarity
• Morning meditation
• Journaling
• Gentle yoga
• Breathwork

If this music helped you, subscribe to Raga Focus for more uninterrupted Indian instrumental music.
